name: Cadaverous Senche-Tiger
related_quests: Casting the Bones: Investigate a necromancer cult searching for a long-dead Dragon.
Pledge: Fang Lair: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Fang Lair.
summary: The Cadaverous Senche-Tiger is a powerful undead skeletal Senche-Tiger found in Fang Lair. It is part of Orryn's Cadaverous Menagerie, also with the Cadaverous Bear, Cadaverous Guar and a pack of Cadaverous Dire Wolves.
